datasetFields.criterion_id: nonempty string; null only while unconfigured
datasetFields.criterion_definition: nonempty independent care criterion; null while unconfigured

collectionTemplateMapping.information_available_at_prediction_time: derive latest_input_available_at_utc from immutable input records, not guessed
